title: Lead iOS & Android Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Build the mobile experience at the heart of our new Customer Portal. We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer (iOS & Android) for our new Customer Portal team within Group Technology in Milton Keynes. You will lead engineering across native iOS and Android applications and the responsive React web experience, delivering secure, reliable and accessible customer journeys while coaching engineers and driving modern practices.

We offer a hybrid working arrangement with 2 days per week in our Milton Keynes office.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead technical delivery across native iOS, native Android and the responsive React web application
  • Define maintainable architecture, coding standards and engineering guardrails across Swift, Kotlin, TypeScript and React
  • Coach mobile and web engineers through technical direction, design and code reviews, pairing and mentoring
  • Deliver secure, accessible, responsive and high-performing customer journeys with consistent design-system implementation
  • Own quality, automated testing, browser and device compatibility, performance, reliability and observability
  • Lead incident response, root-cause analysis and preventative improvement across application channels
  • Work with product, design, quality, platform, security and API teams to resolve dependencies and delivery risks
  • Shape continuous integration and delivery pipelines and govern App Store, Google Play and web releases

Experience and Skills Required:

  • 5 years proven experience leading customer-facing applications across native iOS, native Android and responsive web
  • Strong iOS engineering skills using Swift, SwiftUI and the Apple development ecosystem
  • Strong Android engineering skills using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and the Android development ecosystem
  • Strong responsive web skills using React, TypeScript, modern HTML and CSS
  • Experience and knowledge of C#, .NET, SQL and Microsoft Azure
  • Experience with maintainable architecture, modularisation, reusable components, state management and design systems
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs, identity services, push notifications and analytics platforms
  • Practical knowledge of security, privacy, accessibility, browser behaviour and mobile application lifecycles
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, application signing and mobile and web deployment
  • Working knowledge of Apple App Store, Google Play and modern web release processes
  • Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication skills
  • Experience of coaching engineers at different levels of seniority

Highly Desirable:

  • Experience with React Native or Flutter and the ability to assess when cross-platform approaches are appropriate
  • Experience with feature flagging, phased rollouts, remote configuration and experimentation
  • Experience with biometrics, deep linking, offline capability or secure local storage
  • Experience of AI systems

What We Offer

  • Aviva Digicare + workplace / Car leasing and cycle to work scheme
  • Colleague discount scheme / Perks at work / Gym discounts
  • Life assurance / Workplace pension scheme
  • Collaborative agile environment
  • Ongoing professional development

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Connells Group is an equal opportunities employer committed to a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of ***, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.
